verdict: Alliant Energy earned $398M in Q3, up 42%, as rate-base growth and tax timing lifted EPS to $1.52 — and it lifted its four-year building plan 19% to $15.9B for data-center demand.

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: vs $1.09 a year ago; ongoing EPS was also $1.52

kpis.label: 2027 EPS guidance
kpis.note: ongoing EPS, +8% at the midpoint; dividend target $2.25

segments.name: Electric utility
segments.note: Selling electricity in Iowa (IPL) and Wisconsin (WPL) at regulator-set rates. Growth came from earning returns on a growing rate base — the plants and grid Alliant is building — plus higher retail sales.

segments.name: Gas utility
segments.note: Natural gas distribution in Iowa and Wisconsin — a small, seasonally quiet quarter for heating demand.

segments.name: Other utility
segments.note: Small remaining utility activities outside electricity and gas delivery.

segments.name: Non-utility
segments.note: Non-regulated businesses, mainly Travero, a logistics and transportation company.

opex.name: Depreciation & amortization
opex.note: Spreading the cost of power plants, wind farms and grids over their long lives — it rises as Alliant builds.

opex.name: Other operation & maintenance
opex.note: Running and maintaining generation and distribution day to day ($186M) — up on labor and planned maintenance — plus $17M to run Travero, Alliant's non-utility logistics business.

opex.name: Taxes other than income taxes
opex.note: Mostly property taxes on plants and networks.

opex.name: Energy efficiency costs
opex.note: Programs that help customers use less energy, recovered through rates.

costNote: Electric production fuel and purchased power ($222M), electric transmission service bought from grid operators ($176M) and the cost of gas sold to customers ($13M) — the utility's direct costs.
otherDetail: Net expense of $58M: $145M of interest expense, partly offset by $45M of equity earnings from unconsolidated investments, $38M of allowance for funds used during construction (AFUDC — a regulated-utility credit for equity money tied up in projects being built) and $4M of other income.

takeaways.title: Data centers drive the plan
takeaways.text: Alliant has 3.4 gigawatts of contracted data-center demand and expects peak demand to rise about 60% by 2031 — an industry-leading growth rate that is reshaping its building plans.

takeaways.title: Building plan raised 19%
takeaways.text: The 2027–2030 capex forecast rose 19% to $15.9B. Alliant narrowed 2026 ongoing EPS guidance to $3.41–3.46 (the top half of its range) and set 2027 guidance at $3.63–3.73 with a $2.25 dividend target.

takeaways.title: A tax-timing tailwind
takeaways.text: EPS rose to $1.52 from $1.09 on rate-base growth at IPL and WPL, higher equity earnings, higher AFUDC and the timing of income tax expense — a benefit Alliant says reverses by year-end. Income tax was a $67M benefit this quarter.

footerNote: Utility layout: fuel, purchased power, transmission and gas costs are the direct-cost block; the remaining lines mirror Alliant's income statement. Income tax was a $67M benefit — a negative tax rate is normal for Alliant, which guides to a (28%) consolidated effective rate for 2026 on the strength of tax credits — so tax adds to profit in the flow. Net income is the $398M attributable to Alliant common shareowners.
